sections.shortTitle: Sindh Service Tribunals Second Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 1994
SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNALS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXXII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-27/94, dated
22-2-1995.--The Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Bill, 1994 having
been passed by Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th December, 1994
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 1995 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Service Tribunals Second Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act XV of 1973

ACT XXXII OF 1994
SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNALS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXXII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-27/94, dated
22-2-1995.--The Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Bill, 1994 having
been passed by Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th December, 1994
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 1995 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act XV of 1973.--In the Sindh
Service Tribunals Act, 1973, in section 2, after clause (b), the following
shall be inserted:--
"(bb)
"member of the subordinate judiciary" means a District and Sessions
Judge, Additional District and Sessions Judge, Senior Civil Judge and Assistant
Sessions Judge, Civil Judge and Judicial Magistrate and includes an officer and
servant of the High Court or an employee working under the administrative
control of the District and Sessions Judge wherever he may be. ".
